toggle.label: Share live
toggle.hint: Your position is shared with your other signed-in devices while you record, and stops the moment you save or discard. Not a safety device: never rely on it for help.

link.hint: Anyone with the link can follow this run, no account needed. The link stops working as soon as you save or discard the run.
link.rejected: That link could not be created. Your run is still shared with your own devices.

watch.title: Live run
watch.signalLost: No update for a while. The signal may have dropped, or the run may be on hold.

public.title: Live run
public.nothingHint: If someone sent you this link before their run, keep this page open: it updates on its own once they set off.
